import seaborn as sns

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Calculate total spending per customer
df['Total_Spending'] = df[['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']].sum(axis=1)

# Create an age column
df['Age'] = 2023 - df['Year_Birth']

# Plotting
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Income', y='Total_Spending', hue='Marital_Status', style='Education', size='Age', sizes=(20, 200), alpha=0.6)

# Customizing the plot
plt.title('Customer Spending vs Income with Marital Status and Education Level')
plt.xlabel('Income')
plt.ylabel('Total Spending')
plt.legend(title='Marital Status / Education / Age', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
